static int file_monitor_reload_maybe (  noir_monitor *  m,
char *  tag
)  [static]
 

create per-file events from dir-update event.

this is a helper function. ideally, if a directory is monitored, the backend should send us individual events for each added, deleted modified item. some backends cannot do this; all they send is a change event for the directory itself. if this happens, this routine finds out what really changed and sends more specific events accordingly.

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
m the monitor that the unspecified directory-event occurred on
tag the tag of the directory that changed
